prompt:
Image 1 is a 3 by 2 animation sheet of a chibi game character (6 equal cells, read left to right, top to bottom) taken from a soft video clip. Redraw EXACTLY the same sheet at full resolution with exactly 6 equal cells: in every cell the same pose, the same limb and weapon angles, the same size and the same position inside the cell as Image 1, and the same shape and position of the hair, braid, scarf, cape, tail and every loose cloth piece, because the cells play as one smooth animation. Same camera distance in all cells. No borders between cells. Nothing crosses a cell edge.
Image 2 is the approved crisp drawing of the same character at rest: copy the exact face, eyes, hair colour, ears, costume, every armour piece and ornament, weapon design, tail and colours from Image 2 into every cell, while each cell keeps the pose of Image 1. Take only the rendering and the design details from Image 2, never its pose.
Where an arm, hand or weapon passes in front of the face or hair, draw each part clearly separated (glove, sleeve, hair, face), never melt them into a smudge or a distorted face.
Do not redesign, add or remove anything; no extra weapon, no extra hands. Add no effects at all: no lightning, sparks, glow, aura, magic, speed lines or particles (12/11: a redraw added purple lightning).
Redraw it as a crisp, high-resolution finished game illustration with clean sharp dark outlines, fine readable detail in hair strands, cloth folds and metal, rich saturated colours and clear highlights. No blur, no motion smear, no soft focus, no pixelation. All 6 cells must look like the same drawing: identical line weight, colours and details.
Background 100% solid flat green #00FF00. No gradients in the background, no text, no labels, no shadow on the ground.
Image 3 is a close-up of the staff head in the resting frame: copy it exactly in every cell where the staff shows. The staff head is a thin gold ring with gold spikes (one long spike on top, small spikes around the ring) on a dark shaft, and the ring is HOLLOW: inside it there is only flat background, with a thin violet rim along its inner edge and one small white four-point star floating in the middle. Never a solid orb: no blue, dark, black, rainbow or glowing sphere filling the ring, no gem inside it. The staff is always held in her hand in every cell, never missing.
Nothing on the character may be green: keep every gem, orb and jewel in the exact colours of the soft frame (a blue-purple orb stays blue-purple; 13/11 a redraw turned Lumi's orb green).
The soft clip lost the staff in cell 4 (bottom left) and cell 5 (bottom middle): draw the full staff in both, gripped in her hands, as it swings from cell 3 (held upright beside her on the right of the picture, head up) to cell 6 (lifted with both hands over her left shoulder, head pointing up-left). Cell 4: both hands together in front of her chest, the staff almost upright, its head above the hat brim on the right. Cell 5: hands raised near her face, the staff tilted to the upper left, its head beside the hat crown. Same staff design and length as in cells 3 and 6; the hat and face stay unchanged.

problems.detail: The staff heads in cells 4 and 5 (and the orb in cell 6) look green-filled at this resolution. The prompt requires a hollow ring with a violet rim and a white star, and no green on the character. It is unclear whether the green is just background showing through the ring or a green orb.

precheck.summary: The 3x2 layout, flat green background, character design, hair, and staff presence in all six cells look correct. The only doubt is whether the staff heads in cells 4 to 6 are hollow as specified, which the resolution does not settle.
